timeout.body_one: {{service}} didn't settle within {{count}} minute. Docker may still finish it. Check the service, or roll back.
timeout.body_other: {{service}} didn't settle within {{count}} minutes. Docker may still finish it. Check the service, or roll back.
timeout.waiting_one: {{count}} task was still waiting for the swarm to give it an address.
timeout.waiting_other: {{count}} tasks were still waiting for the swarm to give them addresses.

networkFull.body: {{service}} can't start all its tasks: the network {{network}} has no free addresses in {{subnet}}. Give the network a larger subnet, or run fewer tasks on it, then deploy again.
networkFull.bodyUnnamed: {{service}} can't start all its tasks: one of its networks has no free addresses. Give the network a larger subnet, or run fewer tasks on it, then deploy again.

stopped.body: The swarm stopped updating {{service}}. Check the service, or roll back.

exhausted.body: {{service}}'s tasks stopped and the swarm won't start them again. Check the service's restart policy and its logs, or roll back.

lock.before: Another stack operation is running on {{env}}: {{stack}}, started
lock.reason: Another stack operation is running on {{env}}. Try again when it finishes.
lock.refused: Another stack operation started on {{env}} just now. Try again when it finishes.
